Thanks again for your time earlier, Jordan  good discussion. Quick recap + asks so we can keep momentum with procurement: 

- Commercial path: you mentioned Acme typically does a PO for SaaS vendors and prefers vendor invoices to be billed net-30. Can you confirm whether payments against a contract (SOW) go through Accounts Payable with a PO, or do some BU teams use corporate card?
- Marketplace: you said evaluating AWS Marketplace for select vendors. Is Redwood something you'd prefer to pursue via Marketplace or direct contract? Either works for us, but the contracting/signatory path can change.
- Budget owners & approvals: please confirm the economic buyer and finance sponsor (names/titles) so we know who needs to sign and who owns the OPEX line.
- Docs: attaching a draft SOW and a 1-pg procurement checklist that procurement finds helpful. If procurement needs a vendor form, happy to fill it out  we can pre-populate to speed things up.

Suggested next steps:
1) You loop in Lisa (finance) and procurement contact with the checklist + vendor form (if available).
2) We set a 30-min vendor intake call with procurement & finance this week or early next.
3) If PO is required, confirm invoice cadence and whether vendor tax & W9 are needed.

I'll hold a couple of slots Thu/Fri  let me know what works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,

Thanks Marissa  great recap. Confirming a few items: 

- Commercial path: our standard is PO via Accounts Payable for vendor contracts > $5k. Corporate card is used only for subscriptions under $5k/yr and ad-hoc spend. This will be PO for our expected tier.
- Marketplace: we're open to AWS Marketplace for easier billing, but procurement will prioritize direct contract if there are custom terms (data residency / SLAs). Please indicate if you can support Marketplace listing  we may evaluate both in parallel.
- Budget owners: Lisa Chen (VP Finance) is the finance sponsor; the economic buyer for this initiative is Priya Natarajan, Head of AI Platform (she approved the POV budget). Lisa copied.

I've attached the completed vendor intake form procurement asked for (Acme_Vendor_Form_filled.pdf). Procurement (procurement@acme.com)  can we set a vendor intake call Thursday 11am PT or Friday 9am PT?

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Jordan. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Marketplace: Redwood can support AWS Marketplace listing (we have an existing listing team), but listing timelines can add ~2-4 weeks. If Acme needs to go live faster, direct PO is the faster path. We can run both in parallel if you want Marketplace billing long-term.
- Contract & SOW: the attached SOW is standard; we can update payment terms to net-30. If legal needs redlines, please share them and I can loop in our legal counsel.
- Signatory path: typically the Redwood COO signs enterprise agreements; if Acme requires alternate signatory or countersignature conditions, flag that now.

Marissa  I can join the vendor intake call to answer any technical/ops questions (KV caching, multi-tenant isolation, private deployment options).
